# IF-001 — Order placed event

[Landscape and catalog](../../README.md) · [Catalog source](../../catalog/catalog.json)

## Authentication

Broker service identity with publish/consume permissions.

## Reliability and failure handling

At-least-once delivery; deduplicate by eventId. Retry transient failures, then route to a dead-letter queue.
